SELECT
       IDSKUPUZIV,
       KOD_SKUP_UZIV,
       NAZEV_SKUP_UZIV
FROM QSKUPUZIV
WHERE ({nazev_role} = '' OR NAZEV_SKUP_UZIV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_role}, '%')
       OR KOD_SKUP_UZIV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_role}, '%'))
ORDER BY KOD_SKUP_UZIV;

SELECT
       P.IDSKUPUZIV IDSKUPUZIV_P,
       P.KOD_SKUP_UZIV KOD_SKUP_UZIV_P,
       P.NAZEV_SKUP_UZIV NAZEV_SKUP_UZIV_P,
       R.IDSKUPUZIV IDSKUPUZIV_R,
       R.KOD_SKUP_UZIV KOD_SKUP_UZIV_R,
       R.NAZEV_SKUP_UZIV NAZEV_SKUP_UZIV_R
FROM QSKUPUZIV P
JOIN QSKUPUZIV R ON R.IDSKUPUZIV = P.IDSKUPUZIV_R
ORDER BY P.KOD_SKUP_UZIV, R.KOD_SKUP_UZIV;

SELECT
       IDUZIVATEL,
       KOD_UZIV,
       JMENO_UZIV,
       UZIV_EMAIL
FROM QUZIVATEL_DF
WHERE VLZAKAZPRISTUP = 0
  AND ({jmeno} = '' OR JMENO_UZIV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {jmeno}, '%')
       OR KOD_UZIV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {jmeno}, '%'))
ORDER BY KOD_UZIV;

SELECT
       u.IDUZIVATEL,
       u.KOD_UZIV,
       u.JMENO_UZIV,
       su.IDSKUPUZIV,
       su.KOD_SKUP_UZIV,
       su.NAZEV_SKUP_UZIV
FROM QUZIVATEL_DF u
JOIN QUZVESKUP su ON su.IDUZIVATEL = u.IDUZIVATEL
WHERE ({kod_uzivatele} = '' OR u.KOD_UZIV = {kod_uzivatele})
  AND ({nazev_role} = '' OR su.NAZEV_SKUP_UZIV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_role}, '%')
       OR su.KOD_SKUP_UZIV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_role}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.JMENO_UZIV;

SELECT
       IDSKUPZBOZI,
       KOD_SKUP_ZBOZI,
       NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI
FROM QSKUPZBOZI_DF
WHERE NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI not LIKE 'Z%'
  AND ({nazev_produktu} = '' OR NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_produktu}, '%')
       OR KOD_SKUP_ZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_produktu}, '%'))
ORDER BY NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI;

SELECT
       IDSKUPZNACZBOZI,
       KOD_SKUPZNACZBOZI,
       NAZEV_SKUPZNACZBOZI
FROM QSKUPZNACZBOZI_DF
WHERE NAZEV_SKUPZNACZBOZI not LIKE 'Z%'
  AND ({nazev_trzni_skupiny} = '' OR NAZEV_SKUPZNACZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_trzni_skupiny}, '%')
       OR KOD_SKUPZNACZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_trzni_skupiny}, '%'))
ORDER BY NAZEV_SKUPZNACZBOZI;

SELECT
  pp.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI,
  pp.KOD_PODSKUPZBOZI,
  pp.NAZEV_PODSKUPZBOZI,
  p.NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI
FROM QXXPODSKUPZBOZI pp
JOIN QSKUPZBOZI_DF p ON p.IDSKUPZBOZI = pp.IDSKUPZBOZI
WHERE ({id_produktu} = '' OR pp.IDSKUPZBOZI = {id_produktu})
  AND ({nazev_produktu} = '' OR p.NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_produktu}, '%'))
  AND ({nazev_podproduktu} = '' OR pp.NAZEV_PODSKUPZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_podproduktu}, '%')
       OR pp.KOD_PODSKUPZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_podproduktu}, '%'))
  AND pp.NAZEV_PODSKUPZBOZI not LIKE 'Z%'
ORDER BY p.NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI, pp.NAZEV_PODSKUPZBOZI;

SELECT
       IDSKLAD,
       CIS_SKLAD,
       NAZEV_SKLAD
FROM QSKLAD_DF
WHERE ({nazev_skladu} = '' OR CIS_SKLAD COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_skladu}, '%')
       OR NAZEV_SKLAD COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_skladu}, '%'))
ORDER BY CIS_SKLAD;

SELECT
       IDCENSKZB,
       KOD_CENSKZB,
       NAZEV_CENSKZB
FROM QCENSKZB_DF
WHERE ({nazev_cenove_skupiny} = '' OR KOD_CENSKZB COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_cenove_skupiny}, '%')
       OR NAZEV_CENSKZB COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_cenove_skupiny}, '%'))
ORDER BY KOD_CENSKZB;

SELECT
       z.IDZBOZI,
       z.CIS_ZBOZI,
       z.NAZEV_ZBOZI
FROM QZBOZI_DF z
WHERE z.VLTYP_SLOZ = 1
  AND z.NAZEV_ZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_artiklu}, '%')
ORDER BY z.NAZEV_ZBOZI;

SELECT
       z.IDZBOZI,
       z.CIS_ZBOZI,
       z.NAZEV_ZBOZI
FROM QZBOZI_DF z
JOIN QSKUPZBOZI_DF p ON p.IDSKUPZBOZI = z.IDSKUPZBOZI
WHERE z.VLTYP_SLOZ = 1
  AND p.NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_produktu}, '%')
ORDER BY z.NAZEV_ZBOZI;

SELECT
  IDZBOZI,
  CIS_ZBOZI,
  NAZEV_ZBOZI,
  VLPODTYP_SLOZ
FROM QZBOZI_DF
WHERE VLTYP_SLOZ = 1
  AND VLSTAVZBOZI = 0
ORDER BY NAZEV_ZBOZI;

SELECT
  za.IDXXVYPADKYZASOB,
  a.CIS_ZBOZI,
  a.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
  za.MNZASOBA,
  za.DTDOPLNENI,
  za.MNDOPLNENI
FROM XXVYPADKYZASOB za
JOIN QZBOZI_DF a ON a.IDZBOZI = za.IDZBOZI AND a.VLTYP_SLOZ = 1
WHERE ({id_artiklu} = '' OR za.IDZBOZI = {id_artiklu})
  AND ({kod_artiklu} = '' OR a.CIS_ZBOZI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_artiklu}, '%'))
  AND ({nazev_artiklu} = '' OR a.NAZEV_ZBOZI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_artiklu}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.NAZEV_ZBOZI;

SELECT
       z.IDXXVYPADKYZASOB,
       a.CIS_ZBOZI,
       a.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       z.DTDOPLNENI,
       z.MNDOPLNENI
FROM XXVYPADKYZASOB z
JOIN QZBOZI_DF a ON a.IDZBOZI = z.IDZBOZI AND a.VLTYP_SLOZ = 1
WHERE a.NAZEV_ZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_artiklu}, '%')
  AND z.DTDOPLNENI IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY z.DTDOPLNENI;

SELECT
  u.IDUZIVATEL,
  u.KOD_UZIV,
  u.JMENO_UZIV
FROM QUZIVATEL_DF u
WHERE u.IDUZIVATEL IN (SELECT IDUZIVATEL FROM QUZVESKUP WHERE KOD_SKUP_UZIV = 'OZ')
  AND NOT u.IDUZIVATEL IN (SELECT IDUZIVATEL FROM QUZVESKUP WHERE KOD_SKUP_UZIV = '00')
  AND (u.JMENO_UZIV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {jmeno_uzivatele}, '%')
       OR u.KOD_UZIV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {jmeno_uzivatele}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.JMENO_UZIV;

SELECT
  IDXXPRODAKCE,
  KOD_PRODAKCE
FROM QXXPRODAKCE
WHERE DTPLATI_OD <= GETDATE()
  AND (DTPLATI_DO IS NULL OR DTPLATI_DO >= GETDATE())
ORDER BY KOD_PRODAKCE;

SELECT
       IDCENSKUP,
       CEN_SKUP
FROM QCENSKUP_DF
WHERE CEN_SKUP NOT LIKE '0%'
  AND VLNEAKTIVNI = 0
  AND ({kod_kanalu} = '' OR CEN_SKUP COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_kanalu}, '%'))
ORDER BY CEN_SKUP;

SELECT
  ok.IDCENSKUP,
  ok.CEN_SKUP,
  ts.NAZEV_SKUPZNACZBOZI
FROM QCENSKUP_DF ok
LEFT JOIN QSKUPZNACZBOZI_DF ts ON ts.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI = ok.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI
WHERE ({id_trzni_skupiny} = '' OR ok.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI = {id_trzni_skupiny})
  AND ({nazev_trzni_skupiny} = '' OR ts.NAZEV_SKUPZNACZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_trzni_skupiny}, '%'))
  AND ok.CEN_SKUP NOT LIKE 'Z%'
ORDER BY ts.NAZEV_SKUPZNACZBOZI, ok.CEN_SKUP;

SELECT
  tdm.IDXXTYPDODMIST,
  tdm.KOD_TYPDODMIST,
  ok.CEN_SKUP
FROM QXXTYPDODMIST tdm
JOIN QCENSKUP_DF ok ON ok.IDCENSKUP = tdm.IDCENSKUP
WHERE ({id_obchodniho_kanalu} = '' OR ok.IDCENSKUP = {id_obchodniho_kanalu})
  AND ({kod_kanalu} = '' OR ok.CEN_SKUP COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_kanalu}, '%'))
ORDER BY ok.CEN_SKUP, tdm.KOD_TYPDODMIST;

SELECT
  p.IDSKUPZBOZI,
  p.KOD_SKUP_ZBOZI,
  p.NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI,
  pf.PORADI_F,
  pf.VLVYZNAM_F,
  pf.HDNORMATIV_TRZBY_F
FROM QSKUPZBOZI_DF p
JOIN QXXMEZABC pf ON p.IDSKUPZBOZI = pf.IDSKUPZBOZI
WHERE pf.VLTYP_NASTAVENI = 1
ORDER BY pf.PORADI_F;

SELECT
  p.IDSKUPZBOZI,
  p.KOD_SKUP_ZBOZI,
  p.NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI,
  ts.NAZEV_SKUPZNACZBOZI,
  pts.PORADI_F,
  pts.VLVYZNAM_F,
  pts.HDNORMATIV_TRZBY_F
FROM QSKUPZBOZI_DF p
JOIN  QXXMEZABC pts ON p.IDSKUPZBOZI = pts.IDSKUPZBOZI
JOIN QSKUPZNACZBOZI_DF ts ON ts.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI = pts.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI
WHERE pts.VLTYP_NASTAVENI = 11
  AND ({id_trzni_skupiny} = '' OR pts.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI = {id_trzni_skupiny})
  AND ts.KOD_SKUPZNACZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_trzni_skupiny}, '%')
ORDER BY pts.PORADI_F;

SELECT
  p.IDSKUPZBOZI,
  p.KOD_SKUP_ZBOZI,
  p.NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI,
  ok.CEN_SKUP,
  pok.PORADI_F,
  pok.VLVYZNAM_F,
  pok.HDNORMATIV_TRZBY_F
FROM QSKUPZBOZI_DF p 
JOIN QXXMEZABC pok ON p.IDSKUPZBOZI = pok.IDSKUPZBOZI
JOIN QCENSKUP_DF ok ON ok.IDCENSKUP = pok.IDCENSKUP
WHERE pok.VLTYP_NASTAVENI = 21
  AND ({id_obchodniho_kanalu} = '' OR pok.IDCENSKUP = {id_obchodniho_kanalu})
  AND ok.CEN_SKUP COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_kanalu}, '%')
ORDER BY pok.PORADI_F;

SELECT
  a.IDZBOZI,
  a.CIS_ZBOZI,
  a.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
  ts.NAZEV_SKUPZNACZBOZI,
  ats.VLVYZNAM_Z
FROM QZBOZI_DF a
JOIN QXXTRSKUPZBOZI ats ON a.IDZBOZI = ats.IDZBOZI AND a.VLTYP_SLOZ = 1
JOIN QSKUPZNACZBOZI_DF ts ON ts.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI = ats.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI
WHERE ({id_trzni_skupiny} = '' OR ats.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI = {id_trzni_skupiny})
  AND ts.KOD_SKUPZNACZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_trzni_skupiny}, '%')
ORDER BY a.NAZEV_ZBOZI;

SELECT
  a.IDZBOZI,
  a.CIS_ZBOZI,
  a.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
  ok.CEN_SKUP,
  aok.VLVYZNAM_Z
FROM QZBOZI_DF a
JOIN QXXLISTING aok ON a.IDZBOZI = aok.IDZBOZI AND a.VLTYP_SLOZ = 1
JOIN QCENSKUP_DF ok ON ok.IDCENSKUP = aok.IDCENSKUP
WHERE ({id_obchodniho_kanalu} = '' OR aok.IDCENSKUP = {id_obchodniho_kanalu})
  AND ok.CEN_SKUP COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_kanalu}, '%')
ORDER BY a.NAZEV_ZBOZI;

SELECT
  pp.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI,
  pp.KOD_PODSKUPZBOZI,
  pp.NAZEV_PODSKUPZBOZI,
  sz.NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI,
  ppf.PORADI_F,
  ppf.VLVYZNAM_F,
  ppf.HDNORMATIV_TRZBY_F
FROM QXXPODSKUPZBOZI pp
JOIN QXXMEZABC ppf ON pp.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI = ppf.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI
JOIN QSKUPZBOZI_DF sz ON sz.IDSKUPZBOZI = ppf.IDSKUPZBOZI
WHERE ppf.VLTYP_NASTAVENI = 2
ORDER BY ppf.PORADI_F;

SELECT
  pp.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI,
  pp.KOD_PODSKUPZBOZI,
  pp.NAZEV_PODSKUPZBOZI,
  ts.NAZEV_SKUPZNACZBOZI,
  ppts.PORADI_F,
  ppts.VLVYZNAM_F,
  ppts.HDNORMATIV_TRZBY_F
FROM QXXPODSKUPZBOZI pp
JOIN QXXMEZABC ppts ON pp.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI = ppts.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI
JOIN QSKUPZNACZBOZI_DF ts ON ts.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI = ppts.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI
WHERE ppts.VLTYP_NASTAVENI = 12
  AND ({id_trzni_skupiny} = '' OR ppts.IDSKUPZNACZBOZI = {id_trzni_skupiny})
  AND ts.KOD_SKUPZNACZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_trzni_skupiny}, '%')
ORDER BY ppts.PORADI_F;

SELECT
  pp.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI,
  pp.KOD_PODSKUPZBOZI,
  pp.NAZEV_PODSKUPZBOZI,
  ok.CEN_SKUP,
  ppok.PORADI_F,
  ppok.VLVYZNAM_F,
  ppok.HDNORMATIV_TRZBY_F
FROM QXXPODSKUPZBOZI pp
JOIN QXXMEZABC ppok ON pp.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI = ppok.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI
JOIN QCENSKUP_DF ok ON ok.IDCENSKUP = ppok.IDCENSKUP
WHERE ppok.VLTYP_NASTAVENI = 22
  AND ({id_obchodniho_kanalu} = '' OR ppok.IDCENSKUP = {id_obchodniho_kanalu})
  AND ok.CEN_SKUP COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_kanalu}, '%')
ORDER BY ppok.PORADI_F;

SELECT
  s.IDSUBJEKT,
  s.KOD_SUBJEKTU,
  s.SUBJ_NAZEV,
  ok.CEN_SKUP
FROM QSUBJEKT s
JOIN QSUBJVTSUBJ_DF ov ON ov.IDSUBJEKT = s.IDSUBJEKT AND ov.TYP_SUBJ = 'ODB'
JOIN QCENSKUP_DF ok ON ok.IDCENSKUP = ov.IDCENSKUP
WHERE ({id_obchodniho_kanalu} = '' OR ok.IDCENSKUP = {id_obchodniho_kanalu})
  AND ok.CEN_SKUP LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_kanalu}, '%')
ORDER BY s.SUBJ_NAZEV;

SELECT
  s.IDSUBJEKT,
  s.KOD_SUBJEKTU,
  s.SUBJ_NAZEV
FROM QSUBJEKT s
WHERE ({id_subjektu} = '' OR s.IDSUBJEKT = {id_subjektu})
  AND s.SUBJ_NAZEV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%')
ORDER BY s.SUBJ_NAZEV;

SELECT
      dm.IDSUBJADR,
       dm.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA,
       dm.ULICE,
       dm.MESTO
FROM QSUBJADR_DF dm
JOIN QSUBJEKT s ON s.IDSUBJEKT = dm.IDSUBJEKT
WHERE ({id_subjektu} = '' OR s.IDSUBJEKT = {id_subjektu})
  AND dm.VLSUBJADR_TYP = 2
  AND dm.KOD_STATU = 'CZ'
  AND s.SUBJ_NAZEV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%')
ORDER BY dm.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA;

SELECT
  o.IDSUBJOSOBA,
  o.IDSUBJADR,
  o.JMENO,
  o.FUNKCE,
  o.TEL,
  o.EMAIL
FROM QSUBJOSOBA_DF o
WHERE ({id_dodaciho_mista} = '' OR o.IDSUBJADR = {id_dodaciho_mista})
ORDER BY o.JMENO;

-- Zakázky zákazníka
SELECT 'zakázka' AS typ_zaznamu,
       z.CIS_DOK AS cislo_dokladu,
       z.DTVYSTAVENO AS datum,
       z.DTZDANITPLN AS termin,
       'datum dodání' AS typ_datumu,
       CAST(z.VLSTAVHDOK AS VARCHAR) AS stav
FROM QHDOK_ZAK_DF z
JOIN QSUBJADR_DF dm ON dm.IDSUBJADR = z.IDSUBJADRP
JOIN QSUBJEKT s ON s.IDSUBJEKT = dm.IDSUBJEKT
WHERE ({id_subjektu} = '' OR s.IDSUBJEKT = {id_subjektu})
  AND z.TYP_DOK = 'POB' 
  AND z.HDKUHRADEVAL >= 0
  AND s.SUBJ_NAZEV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%')
UNION ALL
-- Faktury zákazníka
SELECT 'faktura' AS typ_zaznamu,
       f.CIS_DOK AS cislo_dokladu,
       f.DTVYSTAVENO AS datum,
       f.DTSPLATNO AS termin,
       'datum splatnosti' AS typ_datumu,
       CAST(f.VLSTAVHDOK AS VARCHAR) AS stav
FROM QHDOK_FAV_DF f
JOIN QSUBJEKT s ON s.IDSUBJEKT = f.IDSUBJEKT
WHERE ({id_subjektu} = '' OR s.IDSUBJEKT = {id_subjektu})
  AND f.TYP_DOK = 'FVU' 
  AND f.HDKUHRADEVAL >= 0
  AND s.SUBJ_NAZEV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%')
UNION ALL
-- Vratky zákazníka
SELECT 'vratka' AS typ_zaznamu,
       v.CIS_DOK AS cislo_dokladu,
       v.DTVYSTAVENO AS datum,
       v.DTZDANITPLN AS termin,
       'datum stažení' AS typ_datumu,
       CAST(v.VLSTAVHDOK AS VARCHAR) AS stav
FROM QHDOK_ZAK_DF v
JOIN QSUBJADR_DF dm ON dm.IDSUBJADR = v.IDSUBJADRP
JOIN QSUBJEKT s ON s.IDSUBJEKT = dm.IDSUBJEKT
WHERE ({id_subjektu} = '' OR s.IDSUBJEKT = {id_subjektu})
  AND v.TYP_DOK = 'POB' 
  AND v.HDKUHRADEVAL < 0
  AND s.SUBJ_NAZEV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%')
UNION ALL
-- Dobropisy zákazníka
SELECT 'dobropis' AS typ_zaznamu,
       d.CIS_DOK AS cislo_dokladu,
       d.DTVYSTAVENO AS datum,
       d.DTSPLATNO AS termin,
       'datum splatnosti' AS typ_datumu,
       CAST(d.VLSTAVHDOK AS VARCHAR) AS stav
FROM QHDOK_FAV_DF d
JOIN QSUBJEKT s ON s.IDSUBJEKT = d.IDSUBJEKT
WHERE ({id_subjektu} = '' OR s.IDSUBJEKT = {id_subjektu})
  AND d.TYP_DOK = 'FVU' 
  AND d.HDKUHRADEVAL < 0
  AND s.SUBJ_NAZEV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%')
ORDER BY datum DESC;

SELECT
       f.IDHDOK,
       f.CIS_DOK,
       s.SUBJ_NAZEV,
       f.DTVYSTAVENO,
       f.DTSPLATNO,
       f.HDKUHRADEVAL,
       f.VLSTAVHDOK
FROM QHDOK_FAV_DF f
JOIN QSUBJEKT s ON s.IDSUBJEKT = f.IDSUBJEKT
WHERE ({id_subjektu} = '' OR s.IDSUBJEKT = {id_subjektu})
  AND f.TYP_DOK = 'FVU'
  AND f.HDKUHRADEVAL >= 0
  AND s.SUBJ_NAZEV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%')
ORDER BY f.DTVYSTAVENO DESC;

SELECT
        f.IDHDOK,
       f.CIS_DOK,
       s.SUBJ_NAZEV,
       f.DTVYSTAVENO,
       f.DTSPLATNO,
       f.HDKUHRADEVAL,
       f.VLSTAVHDOK
FROM QHDOK_FAV_DF f
JOIN QSUBJEKT s ON s.IDSUBJEKT = f.IDSUBJEKT
WHERE ({id_subjektu} = '' OR s.IDSUBJEKT = {id_subjektu})
  AND f.TYP_DOK = 'FVU'
  AND f.HDKUHRADEVAL >=0
  AND  f.HDKUHRADEVAL > f.HDUHRAZENOVAL
  AND f.DTSPLATNO < GETDATE()
  AND f.VLSTAVHDOK NOT IN (20) -- 20 = Storno
  AND s.SUBJ_NAZEV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%')
ORDER BY f.DTSPLATNO ASC;

SELECT
  z.IDHDOK,
  z.CIS_DOK,
  s.SUBJ_NAZEV,
  dm.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA,
  z.DTZDANITPLN,
  z.HDKUHRADEVAL,
  z.VLSTAVHDOK
FROM QHDOK_ZAK_DF z
JOIN QSUBJADR_DF dm ON dm.IDSUBJADR = z.IDSUBJADRP
JOIN QSUBJEKT s ON s.IDSUBJEKT = dm.IDSUBJEKT
WHERE 
  z.TYP_DOK = 'POB'
  AND z.HDKUHRADEVAL >= 0
  AND dm.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA = {zkratka_dodacího_místa}
  AND @time_grounding(z.DTZDANITPLN)
ORDER BY z.DTZDANITPLN DESC;

SELECT
        z.IDHDOK,
       z.CIS_DOK,
       s.SUBJ_NAZEV,
       dm.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA,

  rt.HDTRZBA_CILOVYNORMATIV_PODPROD,

WHERE rt.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {zkratka_dm}, '%')
ORDER BY rt.HDTRZBA_POTENCIAL_PODPROD DESC;

SELECT TOP 10
  dm.IDSUBJADR,
  rt.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA,
  MAX(rt.DM_NEUPLNA_DATA) AS DM_NEUPLNA_DATA,
  MAX(rt.DM_KONKURENCE_ZAEVIDOVANA) AS DM_KONKURENCE_ZAEVIDOVANA,
  MAX(rt.HDTRZBA_12M_DM) AS HDTRZBA_12M_DM,
  MAX(rt.HDTRZBA_POTENCIAL_DM) AS HDTRZBA_POTENCIAL_DM,
  MAX(rt.HDTRZBA_POTENCIAL_DM) - MAX(rt.HDTRZBA_12M_DM) AS HDTRZBA_POTENCIAL_PODPROD
FROM XXREZERVA_TRZBY rt
-- JOIN přes SUBJADR_POZNAMKA je záměrný (XXREZERVA_TRZBY neobsahuje IDSUBJADR)
LEFT JOIN QSUBJADR_DF dm ON dm.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA = rt.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA and dm.VLSUBJADR_TYP = 2 and dm.KOD_STATU = 'CZ'
GROUP BY dm.IDSUBJADR, rt.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA
ORDER BY HDTRZBA_POTENCIAL_PODPROD DESC;

SELECT TOP 10
  dm.IDSUBJADR,
  rt.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA,
  MAX(rt.DM_NEUPLNA_DATA) AS DM_NEUPLNA_DATA,
  MAX(rt.DM_KONKURENCE_ZAEVIDOVANA) AS DM_KONKURENCE_ZAEVIDOVANA,
  MAX(rt.HDTRZBA_12M_DM) AS HDTRZBA_12M_DM,
  MAX(rt.HDTRZBA_POTENCIAL_DM) AS HDTRZBA_POTENCIAL_DM,
  CAST(ROUND(MAX(rt.HDTRZBA_12M_DM) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(MAX(rt.HDTRZBA_POTENCIAL_DM), 0), 1) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS VYTEZNOST
FROM XXREZERVA_TRZBY rt
-- JOIN přes SUBJADR_POZNAMKA je záměrný (XXREZERVA_TRZBY neobsahuje IDSUBJADR)
LEFT JOIN QSUBJADR_DF dm ON dm.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA = rt.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA and dm.VLSUBJADR_TYP = 2 and dm.KOD_STATU = 'CZ'
GROUP BY dm.IDSUBJADR, rt.SUBJADR_POZNAMKA
HAVING CAST(ROUND(MAX(rt.HDTRZBA_12M_DM) * 100.0
           / NULLIF(MAX(rt.HDTRZBA_POTENCIAL_DM), 0), 1) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) < 50

  CASE WHEN SUM(rt.HDTRZBA_CILOVYNORMATIV_PODPROD) > 0
       THEN ROUND(SUM(rt.HDTRZBA_12M_PODPROD) * 100.0 / SUM(rt.HDTRZBA_CILOVYNORMATIV_PODPROD), 1)

  pr.HDTRZBA_12M
FROM XXPRODEJE pr
LEFT JOIN QCENSKUP_DF ok ON ok.IDCENSKUP = pr.IDCENSKUP

LEFT JOIN QXXPODSKUPZBOZI pp ON pp.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI = pr.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI

SELECT
       Z.IDZBOZI,
       Z.CIS_ZBOZI,
       Z.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       Z.VLPODTYP_SLOZ,
       case Z.VLPODTYP_SLOZ
           when 1 then 'Výrobek'
           when 2 then 'Zboží'
           when 3 then 'Materiál'
           when 4 then 'Polotovar'
           else 'Neznámý'
       end                             AS TYP_ARTIKLU,
       case
           when Z.VLPODTYP_SLOZ in (1,4) then 'Vyráběný'
           when Z.VLPODTYP_SLOZ in (2,3) then 'Nakupovaný'
           else 'Neurčeno'
       end                             AS ZPUSOB_PORIZENI,
       Z.VLSTAVZBOZI,
       case Z.VLSTAVZBOZI
           when 0 then 'Aktivní'
           when 1 then 'Neaktivní'
           else 'Neznámý'
       end                             AS STAV_ARTIKLU,
       SZ.NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI            AS PRODUKT,
       PSZ.NAZEV_PODSKUPZBOZI          AS PODPRODUKT,
       case
           when Z.CIS_ZBOZI = {hledany_vyraz} then 'Kód artiklu'
           when Z.CARKOVY_KOD = {hledany_vyraz} then 'Čárový kód'
           when VMJ.CARKOVY_KODMJ = {hledany_vyraz} then 'Čárový kód obalu'
           when Z.NAZEV_ZBOZI LIKE CONCAT('%', {hledany_vyraz}, '%') then 'Název (fulltext)'
           else 'Jiné'
       end                             AS NALEZENO_PODLE
FROM QZBOZI_DF Z WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN QSKUPZBOZI_DF SZ WITH(NOLOCK) ON SZ.IDSKUPZBOZI = Z.IDSKUPZBOZI
LEFT JOIN QXXPODSKUPZBOZI PSZ WITH(NOLOCK) ON PSZ.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI = Z.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI
LEFT JOIN QZBOZIVMJ_DF VMJ WITH(NOLOCK) ON VMJ.IDZBOZI = Z.IDZBOZI
                                         AND VMJ.CARKOVY_KODMJ = {hledany_vyraz}
WHERE ISNULL(Z.VLSTAVZBOZI, 0) = 0
  AND Z.VLTYP_SLOZ = 1
  AND (
        Z.CIS_ZBOZI = {hledany_vyraz}
     OR Z.CARKOVY_KOD = {hledany_vyraz}
     OR VMJ.CARKOVY_KODMJ = {hledany_vyraz}
     OR Z.NAZEV_ZBOZI LIKE CONCAT('%', {hledany_vyraz}, '%')
      )
ORDER BY
    case
        when Z.CIS_ZBOZI = {hledany_vyraz} then 1
        when Z.CARKOVY_KOD = {hledany_vyraz} then 2
        when VMJ.CARKOVY_KODMJ = {hledany_vyraz} then 3
        else 4
    end,
    Z.CIS_ZBOZI;

SELECT
       ZS.CIS_SKLAD                    AS SKLAD,
       ZS.NAZEV_SKLAD                  AS NAZEV_SKLADU,
       ZS.CIS_ZBOZI,
       ZS.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       ZS.MNFYZICKYSTAV                AS FYZICKY_STAV,
       ZS.MNBLOKOVANO                  AS BLOKOVANO,
       ZS.MNFYZVOLNYSTAV               AS VOLNE,
       ZS.DISPONIBILNI                 AS DISPONIBILNI_PRO_OVERENI,
       ZS.DISPONIBILNI_WMS             AS DISPONIBILNI_STAV,
       ZS.MNFYZICKYSTAV_PAL            AS FYZICKY_STAV_PAL,
       ZS.DISPONIBILNI_PAL             AS DISPONIBILNI_PAL,
       -- Pro Materiál na skladu surovin (04) se bere VOLNE místo DISPONIBILNI
       case
           when Z.VLPODTYP_SLOZ = 3 AND ZS.CIS_SKLAD = '04' then
               case
                   when ZS.MNFYZVOLNYSTAV > 0
                       then 'Skladem (' + CAST(CAST(ZS.MNFYZVOLNYSTAV as int) as varchar(20)) + ' ks volné)'
                   when ZS.MNFYZVOLNYSTAV = 0
                       then 'Nedostupný (0 ks volné)'
                   when ZS.MNFYZVOLNYSTAV < 0
                       then 'Nedostatek (přečerpáno o '
                            + CAST(CAST(ABS(ZS.MNFYZVOLNYSTAV) as int) as varchar(20)) + ' ks)'
                   else 'Stav neznámý'
               end
           else
               case
                   when ZS.DISPONIBILNI > 0
                       then 'Skladem (' + CAST(CAST(ZS.DISPONIBILNI as int) as varchar(20)) + ' ks disp.)'
                   when ZS.DISPONIBILNI = 0
                       then 'Nedostupný (0 ks disp.)'
                   when ZS.DISPONIBILNI < 0
                       then 'Nedostatek (přečerpáno o '
                            + CAST(CAST(ABS(ZS.DISPONIBILNI) as int) as varchar(20)) + ' ks)'
                   else 'Stav neznámý'
               end
       end                             AS STAV_DOSTUPNOSTI,
       case
           when ZS.DISPONIBILNI_WMS > 0 then 'OK'
           when ZS.DISPONIBILNI_WMS <= 0 then 'KRITICKÝ'
           else '?'
       end                             AS DISP_STAV_SIGNAL
FROM QZBOZSKL_DF ZS WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN QZBOZI_DF Z WITH(NOLOCK) ON Z.IDZBOZI = ZS.IDZBOZI
WHERE ({id_artiklu} = '' OR ZS.IDZBOZI = {id_artiklu})
  AND ({kod_artiklu} = '' OR ZS.CIS_ZBOZI = {kod_artiklu})
  AND ({nazev_artiklu} = '' OR ZS.NAZEV_ZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_artiklu}, '%'))
 /* AND ZS.MNFYZICKYSTAV <> 0 */
ORDER BY ZS.CIS_SKLAD;

SELECT
       ZS.CIS_ZBOZI,
       MAX(ZS.NAZEV_ZBOZI)             AS NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       SUM(ZS.MNFYZICKYSTAV)           AS FYZICKY_STAV_CELKEM,
       SUM(ZS.MNBLOKOVANO)             AS BLOKOVANO_CELKEM,
       SUM(ZS.MNFYZVOLNYSTAV)          AS VOLNE_CELKEM,
       SUM(ZS.DISPONIBILNI)            AS DISPONIBILNI_CELKEM,
       SUM(ZS.DISPONIBILNI_WMS)        AS DISPONIBILNI_WMS_CELKEM,
       SUM(ZS.DISPONIBILNI_PAL)        AS DISPONIBILNI_PAL_CELKEM,
       case
           when SUM(ZS.DISPONIBILNI) > 0 then 'Skladem'
           when SUM(ZS.DISPONIBILNI) = 0 then 'Na hranici'
           else 'Nedostatek'
       end                             AS STAV_DOSTUPNOSTI
FROM QZBOZSKL_DF ZS WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE ZS.CIS_ZBOZI = {kod_artiklu}
  AND ZS.MNFYZICKYSTAV <> 0
GROUP BY ZS.CIS_ZBOZI;

SELECT
       PMT.CIS_ZBOZI,
       PMT.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       case PMT.VLPODTYP_SLOZ
           when 1 then 'Výrobek'
           when 2 then 'Zboží'
           when 3 then 'Materiál'
           when 4 then 'Polotovar'
       end                             AS TYP_ARTIKLU,
       case
           when PMT.VLPODTYP_SLOZ in (1,4) then 'Vyráběný'
           when PMT.VLPODTYP_SLOZ in (2,3) then 'Nakupovaný'
           else 'Neurčeno'
       end                             AS ZPUSOB_PORIZENI,
       PMT.CIS_SKLAD                   AS SKLAD,
       PMT.NAZEV_SKLAD,
       PMT.DTDATPOHYBU                 AS TERMIN_DOPLNENI,
       PMT.MNPRIJEMMT                  AS POTVRZENY_PRIJEM,
       PMT.MNNAVRHDOPLN                AS NAVRH_DOPLNENI,
       PMT.MNBUDNAVDOPLN               AS BUDOUCI_NAVRH_DOPLNENI,
       PMT.MNCELKPLANDOPLN             AS CELKOVY_PLAN_DOPLNENI,
       PMT.CIS_SARZE                   AS SARZE,
       PMT.KOD_MJ                      AS MJ,
       PMT.VLSTAVPRIKAZU               AS STAV_PRIKAZU,
       PMT.DTTERMINPRIKAZU             AS TERMIN_PRIKAZU,
       PMT.SUBJ_NAZEV_DOD              AS DODAVATEL,
       PMT.DTDATUMDODANI               AS DATUM_DODANI,
       case
           when PMT.DTDATPOHYBU < GETDATE() then 'Termín prošlý'
           when PMT.DTDATPOHYBU = CAST(GETDATE() as date) then 'Dnes'
           else 'Očekáváno: ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), PMT.DTDATPOHYBU, 104)
       end                             AS INFO_TERMIN
FROM QXXPLANMATTOKU PMT WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE PMT.DTDATPOHYBU >= GETDATE()
  AND PMT.MNPRIJEMMT > 0
  AND PMT.VLTYPPLANUMT IN (2, 4, 6)
  AND PMT.CIS_ZBOZI = {kod_artiklu}
ORDER BY PMT.DTDATPOHYBU ASC, PMT.CIS_SKLAD;

SELECT
       Z.CIS_ZBOZI,
       Z.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       'Vyráběný'                      AS ZPUSOB_PORIZENI,
       TD.TYP_DOK                      AS TYP_DOKLADU,
       case TD.TYP_DOK
           when 'PVY' then 'Příkaz k výrobě'
           when 'PVP' then 'Příkaz k výrobě polotovarů'
           when 'PLV' then 'Plán výroby'
       end                             AS NAZEV_TYPU,
       H.CIS_DOK                       AS CISLO_DOKLADU,
       H.DTVYSTAVENO                   AS DATUM_VYSTAVENI,
       H.DTZDANITPLN                   AS PLAN_DATUM_DOKONCENI,
       H.VLSTAVHDOK                    AS STAV_DOKLADU,
       case H.VLSTAVHDOK
           when -2 then 'Koncept'
           when 0  then 'Rozpracováno'
           when 1  then 'Otevřený'
           when 3  then 'Blokovaný'
           else 'Stav ' + CAST(H.VLSTAVHDOK as varchar(5))
       end                             AS STAV_POPIS,
       SD.MNCELKEMPOCET                AS MNOZSTVI,
       MJ.KOD_MJ                       AS MERNA_JEDNOTKA,
       case
           when H.DTZDANITPLN IS NULL then 'Termín neurčen'
           when H.DTZDANITPLN < GETDATE() then 'Termín prošlý'
           else 'Očekáváno: ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), H.DTZDANITPLN, 104)
       end                             AS INFO_TERMIN
FROM HDOK H WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN TYPDOK TD WITH(NOLOCK) ON TD.IDTYPDOK = H.IDTYPDOK
LEFT JOIN SDOK SD WITH(NOLOCK) ON SD.IDHDOK = H.IDHDOK
                                AND SD.VLTYP_SLOZ IN (1,2)
LEFT JOIN QZBOZI_DF Z WITH(NOLOCK) ON Z.IDZBOZI = SD.IDZBOZI
LEFT JOIN QMJ MJ WITH(NOLOCK) ON MJ.IDMJ = SD.IDMJ
WHERE TD.TYP_DOK IN ('PVY','PVP','PLV')
  AND H.VLSTAVHDOK IN (-2, 0, 1)
  AND Z.CIS_ZBOZI = {kod_artiklu}
ORDER BY H.DTZDANITPLN ASC;

SELECT
       Z.CIS_ZBOZI,
       Z.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       'Nakupovaný'                    AS ZPUSOB_PORIZENI,
       'NOB'                           AS TYP_DOKLADU,
       'Nákupní objednávka'            AS NAZEV_TYPU,
       H.CIS_DOK                       AS CISLO_DOKLADU,
       H.DTVYSTAVENO                   AS DATUM_VYSTAVENI,
       H.DTZDANITPLN                   AS OCEKAVANY_TERMIN_DODANI,
       H.VLSTAVHDOK                    AS STAV_DOKLADU,
       case H.VLSTAVHDOK
           when -2 then 'Koncept'
           when 0  then 'Rozpracováno'
           when 1  then 'Otevřený'
           when 3  then 'Blokovaný'
           when 6  then 'Předfakturováno'
           else 'Stav ' + CAST(H.VLSTAVHDOK as varchar(5))
       end                             AS STAV_POPIS,
       SUBJ.SUBJ_NAZEV                 AS DODAVATEL,
       SD.MNCELKEMPOCET                AS MNOZSTVI,
       MJ.KOD_MJ                       AS MERNA_JEDNOTKA,
       H.JEJICH_CISDOK                 AS CISLO_DODAVATELE,
       case
           when H.DTZDANITPLN IS NULL then 'Termín dodání neurčen'
           when CAST(H.DTZDANITPLN AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date) then 'Dodání v plánu dnes'
           when H.DTZDANITPLN < CAST(GETDATE() AS date) then 'Termín prošlý – zpožděná dodávka'
           else 'Očekáváno: ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), H.DTZDANITPLN, 104)
       end                             AS INFO_TERMIN
FROM HDOK H WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN TYPDOK TD WITH(NOLOCK) ON TD.IDTYPDOK = H.IDTYPDOK
LEFT JOIN SDOK SD WITH(NOLOCK) ON SD.IDHDOK = H.IDHDOK
                                AND SD.VLTYP_SLOZ IN (1,2)
LEFT JOIN QZBOZI_DF Z WITH(NOLOCK) ON Z.IDZBOZI = SD.IDZBOZI
LEFT JOIN QSUBJEKT SUBJ WITH(NOLOCK) ON SUBJ.IDSUBJEKT = H.IDSUBJEKT
LEFT JOIN QMJ MJ WITH(NOLOCK) ON MJ.IDMJ = SD.IDMJ
WHERE TD.TYP_DOK = 'NOB'
  AND H.VLSTAVHDOK IN (-2, 0, 1, 3, 6)
  AND Z.CIS_ZBOZI = {kod_artiklu}
ORDER BY H.DTZDANITPLN ASC;

SELECT MIN(z.IDUCETZAP) AS IDUCETZAP,
       o.UCET_OBD,
       mu.KOD_UKAZMU,
       mu.NAZEV_UKAZMU,
       u.KOD_UCTU,
       u.NAZEV_UCTU,
       SUM(z.HDKON_STAV) AS HDKON_STAV,
       -SUM(z.HDKON_STAV) AS HDSKUT
FROM QUCETZAP z
JOIN QSTRED_DF s ON s.IDSTRED = z.IDSTRED
JOIN QXXUKAZMU mu ON mu.IDXXUKAZMU = s.IDXXUKAZMU
JOIN QUCTOBD o ON o.IDUCTOBD = z.IDUCTOBD
JOIN QUCTOSN_DF u ON u.IDUCTOSN = z.IDUCTOSN
WHERE (mu.KOD_UKAZMU COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT({nazev_ukazatele}, '%')
   OR mu.NAZEV_UKAZMU COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_ukazatele}, '%'))
  AND o.UCET_OBD LIKE CONCAT('%', {obdobi}, '%')
  AND substring(u.KOD_UCTU,1,1) in ('5','6','8','9')
GROUP BY z.IDUCTOBD, z.IDUCTOSN, z.IDSTRED,
         o.UCET_OBD, mu.KOD_UKAZMU, mu.NAZEV_UKAZMU,
         u.KOD_UCTU, u.NAZEV_UCTU
ORDER BY SUM(z.HDKON_STAV) DESC;

SELECT MIN(z.IDUCETZAP) AS IDUCETZAP,
       o.UCET_OBD,
       s.KOD_STR,
       s.NAZEV_STR,
       u.KOD_UCTU,
       u.NAZEV_UCTU,
       SUM(z.HDKON_STAV) AS HDKON_STAV,

FROM QUCETZAP z
JOIN QSTRED_DF s ON s.IDSTRED = z.IDSTRED
JOIN QUCTOBD o ON o.IDUCTOBD = z.IDUCTOBD
JOIN QUCTOSN_DF u ON u.IDUCTOSN = z.IDUCTOSN
WHERE s.IDSTRED = {id_střediska}
  AND o.IDUCTOBD = {id_účetního_období}
  AND substring(u.KOD_UCTU,1,1) in ('5','6','8','9')
GROUP BY z.IDUCTOBD, z.IDUCTOSN, z.IDSTRED,
         o.UCET_OBD, s.KOD_STR, s.NAZEV_STR,
         u.KOD_UCTU, u.NAZEV_UCTU
ORDER BY SUM(z.HDKON_STAV) DESC;

SELECT MIN(z.IDUCETZAP) AS IDUCETZAP,
       o.UCET_OBD,
       u.KOD_UCTU,
       u.NAZEV_UCTU,
       s.KOD_STR,
       s.NAZEV_STR,
       SUM(z.HDKON_STAV) AS HDKON_STAV,
       -SUM(z.HDKON_STAV) AS HDSKUT
FROM QUCETZAP z
JOIN QUCTOSN_DF u ON u.IDUCTOSN = z.IDUCTOSN
JOIN QUCTOBD o ON o.IDUCTOBD = z.IDUCTOBD
JOIN QSTRED_DF s ON s.IDSTRED = z.IDSTRED
WHERE (u.KOD_UCTU COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT({nazev_uctu}, '%')
   OR u.NAZEV_UCTU COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_uctu}, '%'))
  AND o.UCET_OBD LIKE CONCAT('%', {obdobi}, '%')
  AND substring(u.KOD_UCTU,1,1) in ('5','6','8','9')
GROUP BY z.IDUCTOBD, z.IDUCTOSN, z.IDSTRED,
         o.UCET_OBD, u.KOD_UCTU, u.NAZEV_UCTU,
         s.KOD_STR, s.NAZEV_STR
ORDER BY SUM(z.HDKON_STAV) DESC;

SELECT z.IDUCETZAP,
       o.UCET_OBD,
       u.KOD_UCTU,
       u.NAZEV_UCTU,
       s.KOD_STR,
       s.NAZEV_STR,
       z.HDKON_STAV AS HDKON_STAV,
       -z.HDKON_STAV AS HDSKUT,
       d.CIS_DOK,
       z.UZTEXT,
       d.SLOZKA_IDENT
FROM QUCETZAP z
JOIN QUCTOBD o ON o.IDUCTOBD = z.IDUCTOBD
JOIN QUCTOSN_DF u ON u.IDUCTOSN = z.IDUCTOSN
JOIN QSTRED_DF s ON s.IDSTRED = z.IDSTRED
LEFT JOIN QSDOK d ON d.IDSDOK = z.IDSDOK
WHERE z.IDUCTOBD = (SELECT TOP 1 r.IDUCTOBD FROM QUCETZAP r WHERE r.IDUCETZAP = {id_ucetniho_zapisu})
  AND z.IDUCTOSN = (SELECT TOP 1 r.IDUCTOSN FROM QUCETZAP r WHERE r.IDUCETZAP = {id_ucetniho_zapisu})
  AND z.IDSTRED = (SELECT TOP 1 r.IDSTRED FROM QUCETZAP r WHERE r.IDUCETZAP = {id_ucetniho_zapisu})
ORDER BY z.HDKON_STAV DESC;

WITH z AS
  (SELECT r.IDHDOK, r.IDSDOK FROM QUCETZAP r WHERE r.IDUCETZAP = {id_ucetniho_zapisu})
SELECT s.IDSDOK,
       t.NAZEV_TYPDOK,
       d.CIS_DOK,
       d.DTZDANITPLN,
       d.IDSUBJEKT,
       s.ZAK_SDOK,
       d.TEXTPOZN,
       s.PORADI_DOK,
       s.VLTYP_SLOZ,
       s.KOD_POHYB,
       s.SLOZKA_IDENT,
       s.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       s.TEXT_SLOZ,
       s.MNPOCETMJ,
       s.HDJCENAKC,
       s.HDCCENAKC
FROM QHDOK d
LEFT JOIN QTYPDOK t ON t.IDTYPDOK = d.IDTYPDOK
LEFT JOIN QSDOK s ON s.IDSDOK = (SELECT IDSDOK FROM z)
WHERE d.IDHDOK = (SELECT IDHDOK FROM z)
ORDER BY s.PORADI_DOK;

SELECT
       IDUCTOSN,
       KOD_UCTU,
       NAZEV_UCTU
FROM QUCTOSN_DF
WHERE substring(KOD_UCTU,1,1) in ('5','6','8','9')
  AND len(KOD_UCTU) = 6
  AND ({nazev_uctu} = '' OR KOD_UCTU COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_uctu}, '%')
       OR NAZEV_UCTU COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_uctu}, '%'))
ORDER BY KOD_UCTU;

SELECT
       IDSTRED,
       KOD_STR,
       NAZEV_STR
FROM QSTRED_DF
WHERE ({nazev_strediska} = '' OR KOD_STR COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_strediska}, '%')
       OR NAZEV_STR COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_strediska}, '%'))
ORDER BY KOD_STR;

SELECT
       IDXXUKAZMU,
       KOD_UKAZMU,
       NAZEV_UKAZMU
FROM QXXUKAZMU
WHERE ({nazev_ukazatele} = '' OR KOD_UKAZMU COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_ukazatele}, '%')
       OR NAZEV_UKAZMU COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_ukazatele}, '%'))
ORDER BY KOD_UKAZMU;

SELECT
       QSUBJEKT.IDSUBJEKT,
       QSUBJEKT.KOD_SUBJEKTU,
       QSUBJEKT.SUBJ_NAZEV,
       QZBOZI_DF.IDZBOZI,
       QZBOZI_DF.CIS_ZBOZI,
       QZBOZI_DF.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       QCENSKUP_DF.CEN_SKUP,
       CONVERT(decimal(18,4), dbo.fnXXOZ_JCenaNaObjednavceSubjekt(QZBOZI_DF.IDZBOZI, QSUBJEKT.IDSUBJEKT, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))) AS CENA_SUBJEKT,
       CONVERT(decimal(18,4), dbo.fnXXOZ_JCenaNaObjednavce(QZBOZI_DF.IDZBOZI, QSUBJVTSUBJ_DF.IDCENSKUP, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))) AS CENA_KANAL,
       CONVERT(decimal(18,4), ISNULL(dbo.fnXXOZ_JCenaNaObjednavceSubjekt(QZBOZI_DF.IDZBOZI, QSUBJEKT.IDSUBJEKT, CONVERT(date, GETDATE())),
                                     dbo.fnXXOZ_JCenaNaObjednavce(QZBOZI_DF.IDZBOZI, QSUBJVTSUBJ_DF.IDCENSKUP, CONVERT(date, GETDATE())))) AS CENA_VYSLEDNA
FROM QSUBJEKT
JOIN QSUBJVTSUBJ_DF ON QSUBJVTSUBJ_DF.IDSUBJEKT = QSUBJEKT.IDSUBJEKT AND QSUBJVTSUBJ_DF.TYP_SUBJ = 'ODB'
JOIN QCENSKUP_DF ON QCENSKUP_DF.IDCENSKUP = QSUBJVTSUBJ_DF.IDCENSKUP
JOIN QZBOZI_DF ON QZBOZI_DF.VLTYP_SLOZ = 1 AND QZBOZI_DF.VLSTAVZBOZI = 0
WHERE (QSUBJEKT.SUBJ_NAZEV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%')
       OR QSUBJEKT.KOD_SUBJEKTU COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%'))
  AND (QZBOZI_DF.CIS_ZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_artiklu}, '%')
       OR QZBOZI_DF.NAZEV_ZBOZI COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_artiklu}, '%'))
ORDER BY QSUBJEKT.SUBJ_NAZEV, QZBOZI_DF.NAZEV_ZBOZI;

SELECT
       QCESKZBPA_DF.IDCESKZBPA,
       QSUBJEKT.KOD_SUBJEKTU,
       QSUBJEKT.SUBJ_NAZEV,
       QZBOZI_DF.CIS_ZBOZI,
       QZBOZI_DF.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       QCENSKZB_DF.KOD_CENSKZB,
       QSKUPZBOZI_DF.NAZEV_SKUP_ZBOZI,
       QXXPODSKUPZBOZI.NAZEV_PODSKUPZBOZI,
       QCESKZBPA_DF.PREDPIS_CENA,
       CASE
            WHEN QCESKZBPA_DF.IDZBOZI IS NOT NULL AND QCESKZBPA_DF.PREDPIS_CENA NOT LIKE '%@%' THEN 'P1'
            WHEN QCESKZBPA_DF.IDZBOZI IS NOT NULL THEN 'P2'
            WHEN QCESKZBPA_DF.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI IS NOT NULL THEN 'P3'
            WHEN QCESKZBPA_DF.IDSKUPZBOZI IS NOT NULL THEN 'P4'
            WHEN QCENSKZB_DF.KOD_CENSKZB = 'Sortiment DF' THEN 'P6'
            ELSE 'P5'
       END AS PRIORITA,
       QCESKZBPA_DF.DTPLATI_OD,
       QCESKZBPA_DF.DTPLATI_DO
FROM QCESKZBPA_DF
JOIN QSUBJEKT ON QSUBJEKT.IDSUBJEKT = QCESKZBPA_DF.IDSUBJEKT
LEFT JOIN QZBOZI_DF ON QZBOZI_DF.IDZBOZI = QCESKZBPA_DF.IDZBOZI
LEFT JOIN QCENSKZB_DF ON QCENSKZB_DF.IDCENSKZB = QCESKZBPA_DF.IDCENSKZB
LEFT JOIN QSKUPZBOZI_DF ON QSKUPZBOZI_DF.IDSKUPZBOZI = QCESKZBPA_DF.IDSKUPZBOZI
LEFT JOIN QXXPODSKUPZBOZI ON QXXPODSKUPZBOZI.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI = QCESKZBPA_DF.IDXXPODSKUPZBOZI
WHERE QCESKZBPA_DF.VLPROCENU = 2
  AND CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) BETWEEN QCESKZBPA_DF.DTPLATI_OD AND ISNULL(QCESKZBPA_DF.DTPLATI_DO, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))
  AND (QSUBJEKT.SUBJ_NAZEV COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%')
       OR QSUBJEKT.KOD_SUBJEKTU COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {nazev_zakaznika}, '%'))
ORDER BY QSUBJEKT.SUBJ_NAZEV, PRIORITA, QCENSKZB_DF.KOD_CENSKZB;

SELECT
       QCESKZBPA_DF.IDCESKZBPA,
       QCENSKUP_DF.CEN_SKUP,
       QZBOZI_DF.CIS_ZBOZI,
       QZBOZI_DF.NAZEV_ZBOZI,
       QCESKZBPA_DF.PREDPIS_CENA,
       QCESKZBPA_DF.DTPLATI_OD,
       QCESKZBPA_DF.DTPLATI_DO
FROM QCESKZBPA_DF
JOIN QCENSKUP_DF ON QCENSKUP_DF.IDCENSKUP = QCESKZBPA_DF.IDCENSKUP
LEFT JOIN QZBOZI_DF ON QZBOZI_DF.IDZBOZI = QCESKZBPA_DF.IDZBOZI
WHERE QCESKZBPA_DF.VLPROCENU = 2
  AND QCESKZBPA_DF.IDSUBJEKT IS NULL
  AND CONVERT(date, GETDATE()) BETWEEN QCESKZBPA_DF.DTPLATI_OD AND ISNULL(QCESKZBPA_DF.DTPLATI_DO, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))
  AND QCENSKUP_DF.CEN_SKUP LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_kanalu}, '%')
ORDER BY QCENSKUP_DF.CEN_SKUP, QZBOZI_DF.NAZEV_ZBOZI;

SELECT
       XXSLEVPAS.IDXXSLEVPAS,
       QCENSKUP_DF.CEN_SKUP,
       QCENSKZB_DF.KOD_CENSKZB,
       QCENSKZB_DF.NAZEV_CENSKZB,
       XXSLEVPAS.HDDOLMEZ,
       XXSLEVPAS.HDHORMEZ,
       XXSLEVPAS.HDMINSLEVA,
       XXSLEVPAS.HDMAXSLEVA
FROM XXSLEVPAS
JOIN QCENSKUP_DF ON QCENSKUP_DF.IDCENSKUP = XXSLEVPAS.IDCENSKUP
JOIN QCENSKZB_DF ON QCENSKZB_DF.IDCENSKZB = XXSLEVPAS.IDCENSKZB
WHERE XXSLEVPAS.VLPRIRAZENI = 0
  AND ({kod_kanalu} = '' OR QCENSKUP_DF.CEN_SKUP COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_kanalu}, '%'))
  AND ({kod_znacky} = '' OR QCENSKZB_DF.KOD_CENSKZB COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI LIKE CONCAT('%', {kod_znacky}, '%'))
ORDER BY QCENSKUP_DF.CEN_SKUP, QCENSKZB_DF.KOD_CENSKZB, XXSLEVPAS.HDDOLMEZ;
